summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due October 18, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000 Index, and S&P 500 Index. The aggregate principal amount is left blank, pricing date is October 9, 2026, original issue date October 19, 2026, with quarterly contingent coupons of $24.13 and quarterly autocall observations beginning October 11, 2027. This is a routine Series A Global Medium-Term Notes shelf takedown, not a special situation; payments are senior unsecured obligations subject to credit risk.
